meetingInstanceId.description: The meeting identifier for the specific meeting instance.

webexUserName.description: The display name of the participant of this media session.

webexUserEmail.description: The email address of the participant of this media session.

joinTime.description: The date and time when this participant joined the meeting.

leaveTime.description: The date and time when this participant left the meeting.

joinMeetingTime.description: The join meeting time of the participant.

clientType.description: The type of the client (and OS) used by this media session.

clientVersion.description: The version of the client used by this media session.

osType.description: The operating system used for the client.

osVersion.description: The version of the operating system used for the client.

hardwareType.description: The type of hardware used to attend the meeting

speakerName.description: A description of the speaker used in the meeting.

localIP.description: The local IP address of the client.

publicIP.description: The public IP address of the client.

maskedLocalIP.description: The masked local IP address of the client.

maskedPublicIP.description: The masked public IP address of the client.

camera.description: A description of the camera used in the meeting.

microphone.description: A description of the microphone used in the meeting.

participantSessionId.description: Identifies a specific session the participant has in a given meeting.

videoIn.description: The collection of downstream (sent to the client) video quality data.

videoOut.description: The collection of upstream (sent from the client) video quality data.

audioIn.description: The collection of downstream (sent to the client) audio quality data.

audioOut.description: The collection of upstream (sent from the client) audio quality data.

shareIn.description: The collection of downstream (sent to the client) share quality data.

shareOut.description: The collection of upstream (sent from the client) share quality data.

resources.description: Device resources such as CPU and memory.
